$comment: Canonical attribution data. Edit this file only; ATTRIBUTION.md is generated from it by scripts/generate-attribution.mjs and CI fails if the two diverge. Dispositions are recorded in codrona-docs/LEGAL.md.

sources.name: IBM Project CodeNet
sources.role: Training corpus — submissions and problems from Aizu Online Judge and AtCoder
sources.notice: Contains information from IBM Project CodeNet, made available by IBM Research under the Community Data License Agreement – Permissive – Version 2.0.

sources.name: Codeforces
sources.licence: No licence stated; site Terms govern
sources.role: Training corpus and live integration — submission metadata via the official API
sources.notice: Problem, contest and submission metadata retrieved from the official Codeforces API. Codeforces is operated by CODEFORCES GLOBAL - FZCO and is not affiliated with Codrona.
conditions: Problem statements and editorials are never stored or served; every problem reference links to codeforces.com.
Requests are rate-limited to one per two seconds through a single shared limiter.

sources.name: CodeContests
sources.role: Problem statements, test cases and human solutions — CodeNet-sourced problems only
sources.notice: Contains materials from CodeContests by Google DeepMind, used under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence. CodeContests is not an official Google product.
sources.citation: Li et al., "Competition-level code generation with AlphaCode", Science 378(6624), 1092–1097, 2022. doi:10.1126/science.abq1158
conditions: Only problems sourced from IBM Project CodeNet (Aizu, AtCoder) are used.
Codeforces-sourced and description2code-sourced problems are excluded.

sources.name: LeetCode problem difficulty estimates
sources.notice: LeetCode problem difficulty estimates by Shuxin Chen (zerotrac), used under the MIT licence. Copyright (c) 2021 Shuxin Chen.
conditions: These are community estimates computed by Elo and maximum likelihood estimation, not official LeetCode difficulty, and are labelled as such wherever displayed.
Weekly contests 1–62 carry no estimate; Codrona's own model is used instead.

sources.name: AtCoder
sources.role: Not used as a training corpus
sources.notice: AtCoder submission data is not ingested by Codrona. AtCoder Inc. licenses submission data directly to third parties, and the bulk community mirrors carry no AI-training opt-out signal. AtCoder problems reach Codrona only through IBM Project CodeNet, under that dataset's own licence.

sources.name: AtCoder Problems
sources.licence: MIT (application code only; no licence stated for data)
sources.role: Not used as a training corpus
sources.notice: The AtCoder Problems bulk submission dataset is not ingested by Codrona. Where a user connects their own AtCoder handle, their public submission list may be read through this unofficial API at no more than one request per second, as profile data only.
